description: Compact, privacy-minimized selections from already persisted FEC PAC/party summary and Senate LDA filings. No person-to-person inference or transaction-level donor-to-recipient transfers.
limitations: Only 135 FEC PAC and party cycle summary records selected from already indexed committee IDs. Not a census of all PACs or party committees.
2024 FEC committee summaries generally end December 31, 2024; 2026  summaries have a different reporting cutoff. Compare only like-for-like periods.
Receipts include transfers and cannot be equated with spending on candidates. Payments to recipients are not established by these summaries.
The 56 LDA filings are bounded query matches; they record lobbying activity, not proof of a donor, expenditure, or legislative influence. Specific issue excerpts remain unreviewed.
No donor-to-PAC-to-candidate graph is evidenced by these combined datasets. IRS, state, and nonprofit databases are separate lookup sources until matching records are actually ingested.
